import json,sys,bisect,ipaddress as ip,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
import test_dp as D, validate
from reference import reference_runs
from audit import LANES
payload = open('/tmp/dpcase.json').read()
req=validate.parse_request(payload.encode())[0]
fib={}
for route,hop in req['initial']: fib[route]=hop
fibs=[dict(fib)]
for tx in req['transactions']:
    for op,route,hop in tx:
        if op=='set': fib[route]=hop
        elif route in fib: del fib[route]
    fibs.append(dict(fib))
hit,miss,dec=req['costs']
for vi in range(3):
    v=fibs[vi]
    starts,hops=reference_runs(v)
    bl=[(rep,[bisect.bisect_right(starts,int(ip.IPv6Address(a)))-1 for a in addrs]) for vv,rep,addrs in req['bursts'] if vv==vi]
    fr=D.version_frontier(starts,bl,6,hit,miss,dec)
    print('v',vi,'R',len(starts),'python frontier:',sorted(fr))
    for C in range(0,7):
        lines=['PLAN 1 %d %d %d %d %d %d %d'%(C,hit,miss,dec[0],dec[1],dec[2])]
        lines.append(str(len(starts)))
        lines+=['%032x %d'%(s,-1 if h is None else h) for s,h in zip(starts,hops)]
        lines.append(str(len(bl)))
        for rep,runs_of in bl:
            lines.append('%d %d%s'%(rep,len(runs_of),''.join(' %d'%x for x in runs_of)))
        p=subprocess.run(['/workspace/tmp/engine'],input='\n'.join(lines).encode()+b'\n',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        if p.returncode: print('  C=%d ENGINE FAIL'%C, p.stderr.decode()); continue
        rows=p.stdout.decode().split('\n')
        n=int(rows[0]); layout=[]
        for k in range(n):
            parts=rows[1+k].split()
            lo,span,mode,cached,b=(int(x) for x in parts[:5])
            layout.append((lo,span,mode,cached,[int(x) for x in parts[5:]]))
        # evaluate this layout
        img=validate.decode_image(subprocess.run(['/workspace/tmp/engine'],input=('\n'.join(['PACK %d %d 0'%(len(starts),len(layout))]+['%032x %d'%(s,-1 if h is None else h) for s,h in zip(starts,hops)]+[' '.join(map(str,[lo,span,mode,cached,len(ch)]+ch)) for lo,span,mode,cached,ch in layout])+'\n').encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout.decode().split()[0],starts,hops)[0]
        resident=sum(x['pages'] for x in img.values() if x['cached'])
        work=0
        for rep,runs_of in bl:
            visits={}
            for k in runs_of: visits[k]=visits.get(k,0)+1
            # approximate: walk each address
            pass
        # compute work by node formula using T/Q from python frontier calc
        import test_dp as DD
        weights=[0]*len(starts); hitsets=[]
        for rep,runs_of in bl:
            for k in runs_of: weights[k]+=rep
            hitsets.append((rep,set(runs_of)))
        wsum=[0]
        for x in weights: wsum.append(wsum[-1]+x)
        def Q(i,j): return wsum[j]-wsum[i]
        def T(i,j): return sum(r for r,hs in hitsets if any(i<=k<j for k in hs))
        work=0; pages=0
        for off,nd in img.items():
            P=nd['pages'];K=len(nd['keys'])
            i=nd['lo'];s=nd['span']
            coeff=(K+LANES[nd['mode']]-1)//LANES[nd['mode']]+dec[nd['mode']]
            work+=P*(hit if nd['cached'] else miss)*T(i,i+s)+coeff*Q(i,i+s)
            pages+=P
        fixed=1+(len(starts)*4+63)//64
        print('  C=%d -> work %d pages %d resident %d'%(C,work,pages+fixed,resident))
